title: Swappable application-send turn planner work item
summary: Add a connection-local internal application-send turn-planning seam whose null default preserves the current scheduler and whose alternate path can select only an existing queued-write index without bypassing runtime send budgets or ownership boundaries.
planned_changes: Introduce a per-connection internal turn planner contract, preserve the existing static scheduler as both the null fast path and an explicit control implementation, inject per-connection planners through the internal listener boundary, add policy parity and isolation tests, add a permanent dispatch-cost benchmark, and run matched local HTTP/3 and public QUIC guardrails before accepting the seam.
verification_plan: Validate individual SpecTrace artifacts, run focused scheduler/listener/stream ownership tests, run BenchmarkDotNet Dry and Short jobs for direct/default/explicit policy dispatch, run matched current-baseline versus candidate HTTP/3 fixed 1 MiB at 1 x 1, 1 x 4, and 1 x 16 plus public QUIC download and duplex 1 x 16 controls, then run the complete Release regression suite if the seam is retained.
out_of_scope: Promoting same-priority stream rotation or adjacent-write accumulation
Changing congestion, anti-amplification, retransmission, flow-control, ACK, packet-protection, or public completion semantics
Adding a public scheduler option or static mutable process-wide override
Claiming a throughput improvement from the policy seam alone
Running or publishing ProtocolLab evidence unless a later policy passes the local promotion gate
